# pai notify

Notification settings: status, set, test, send

```
pai notify <command>
```

Notification settings: status, set, test, send.

```sh
pai notify status
pai notify test
```

### pai notify status

Show the notification mode and active channels

```
pai notify status
```

Show the notification mode and active channels.

Show current notification mode and active channels

```sh
pai notify status
pai notify status
```

See also: `pai notify get`

### pai notify get

Same as status

```
pai notify get
```

Same as status.

Show current notification config (alias for status)

```sh
pai notify get
pai notify status
```

See also: `pai notify set`, `pai notify status`

### pai notify set

Change the notification mode or channels

```
pai notify set [MORE...] [options]
```

Change the notification mode or channels.

Update notification mode or channel configuration

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `MORE...` | no | More values for the list option above |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--mode MODE` | string | — | Notification mode: auto | voice | whatsapp | ntfy | macos | cli | off |
| `--enable CHANNEL` | string | — | Enable one or more channels (several values allowed) |
| `--disable CHANNEL` | string | — | Disable one or more channels (several values allowed) |
| `--ntfy-url URL` | string | — | Set the ntfy.sh topic URL |
| `--ntfy-priority LEVEL` | string | — | Set ntfy priority: min | low | default | high | urgent |
| `--whatsapp-recipient CONTACT` | string | — | Set WhatsApp recipient |

```sh
pai notify set --mode auto
pai notify set --enable ntfy --disable whatsapp
```

See also: `pai notify test`, `pai notify get`

### pai notify test

Send a test notification

```
pai notify test [options]
```

Send a test notification.

Send a test notification through configured channels

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--event EVENT` | string | — | Event type to test: error | progress | completion | info | debug |

```sh
pai notify test
pai notify test --event error
```

See also: `pai notify send`, `pai notify set`

### pai notify send

Send a notification with an event type and message

```
pai notify send EVENT MESSAGE [options]
```

Send a notification with an event type and message.

Send a notification with an explicit event type and message

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `EVENT` | yes | Event type, e.g. info or error |
| `MESSAGE` | yes | Message text, in quotes |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--title TITLE` | string | — | Optional notification title |

```sh
pai notify send info "Build finished"
pai notify send error "Build failed" --title CI
```

See also: `pai notify test`

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `pai notify status` | Show the notification mode and active channels |
| `pai notify get` | Same as status |
| `pai notify set` | Change the notification mode or channels |
| `pai notify test` | Send a test notification |
| `pai notify send` | Send a notification with an event type and message |
